$comment: Known design-rule violations, recorded per file by bin/verify-design-rules.ts. This is a ratchet, not an allowlist: a count that rises fails as a new violation, and a count that falls fails until it is lowered here, so a fix cannot regress later. Do not edit by hand — run `pnpm -F ranui verify:design --update-baseline`. The rules themselves are stated in docs/DESIGN.md and CLAUDE.md.
